answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the anchor binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The ferrous explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Splitting into 8 separate vaults requires a separate funded trellis account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The deposit is 21 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
